_doc: Issue cost (cycles a thread's issue slot is occupied) per Quasar Tensix instruction, for the no-stall floor in perf_headroom.py. Issue cost is NOT result latency: a dependent instruction waiting on a result shows up as a stall in the wave breakdown, not here. Every entry must cite a public source. Numbers known only from internal docs or measured on waves go in the private override (llk_code_gen tools/llk_wave_debug/codegen/llk_wave_debug/rates/quasar_issue_rates.private.json), passed as a later --rates.

default.source: assumption: one instruction issued per thread per cycle; NOP descriptions in tt_llk_quasar/instructions/assembly.yaml ('consume an instruction slot and cycle'). Opcodes that fall back to this are listed in the verdict's defaulted_opcodes.
